name: SlideForge
description:
SlideForge turns typed slide intents into native, fully editable PowerPoint files — deterministically. Pick one of 150+ catalog forms (KPI dashboards, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, funnels, comparison matrices, and more), put your real content in typed fields, and a deterministic engine binds it verbatim: no LLM in the render path, same input renders the same slide, usually in under a second. Plain-language briefs work too — the engine routes them to the right form.

Setup — do this after connecting: open the ⊕ menu → Connectors → Tool access → "Tools already loaded". Claude's default, "Load tools when needed", keeps connector tools out of context, so Claude will build slides with its own built-in tools instead of using SlideForge. The setting is global and only needs to be set once.

Built for trust in business material: every response carries a fidelity manifest stating, per field, whether content was bound verbatim or model-completed; slides with blocking defects never bill (usable-or-free); free dry runs validate any payload before you spend. Whole decks render in parallel into one themed .pptx with a per-slide fidelity rollup — failed slides are isolated and free. Translate decks into 32 languages with formatting preserved, convert PDFs into editable decks, and apply brand themes extracted from your own PPTX. For layouts outside the catalog, mode=code runs your own python-pptx in a sandbox under the same trust contract.

Pricing: creating a slide $0.05, transforming a slide $0.02, checking free. 60 free slides on signup, no credit card, no subscription. By Smart Data Brokers GmbH, Switzerland.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SlideForge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SlideForge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.slideforge.dev/mcp-connectors. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SlideForge MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SlideForge provides these MCP tools: browse_catalog, create_deck, create_slide, manage_account, plan_slide, translate_deck, and upload_asset.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SlideForge?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SlideForge in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SlideForge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SlideForge is developed by Smart Data Brokers GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
